[[Glint's Challenge]] is a [[challenge mission]] in the [[Depths of Tyria]]. The goal is to protect Glint's offspring from an onslaught of destroyers. To start this mission, speak with [[Consular Brand Oakencask]] at the [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. 

==Mission information==
===Objectives===
* Protect the [[Baby Dragon]] at all costs.
** Survive all six waves of [[destroyer]]s.
** Destroy enemy waves quickly to earn points; the faster you kill the more points you earn.
**Earn bonus points for each Dwarf defender who survives the assault.

===Rewards===
*After the party defeats the final wave, a [[Chest of the Brotherhood]] will spawn, which drops a [[Cloth of the Brotherhood]] and a [[Destroyer Core]] (in [[Hard Mode]] one [[Cloth of the Brotherhood]] and 5 [[Destroyer Cores]]) for each member.
*25 [[Dwarf reputation point]]s per wave defeated, awarded immediately after each wave ends (End round 1 -- 25 points, End round 3 -- 75 points).

==== Records ====
Updated scores appear on [[Consular Rahburt]]'s record board, shortly after the old ones are broken.

* Each party member will be awarded 1500 [[Delver]] Reputation points should they break the daily record.

* Each party member will be awarded 3000 Delver Reputation points should they break the monthly record.

* Each party member will be awarded 6000 Delver Reputation points should they break the quarterly record (3 months).

==Walkthrough==
The main mission area contains three entrances to a room with the [[Baby Dragon]]. The rear entrance connects to an elevated loop that encircles the arena. There are two side gates which lead to pathways and monster spawn points. In the center, the baby dragon rests on an elevated platform.

You will be attacked by six waves consisting of different types of [[Destroyers]]. A new wave starts immediately after the last destroyer of the previous wave has been killed. The party gains a morale boost every time a new wave starts.

* The first wave consists of a constant swarm of weak level 10 and 15 [[Destroyer of Souls|Destroyers of Souls]] and [[Destroyer of Hordes|Destroyers of Hordes]], along with some level 20 [[Destroyer of Thoughts|Destroyers of Thoughts]] for about two minutes and thirty seconds (last spawn at 2:25).  Splitting into two groups along the two paths and killing the monsters at their spawn points is effective. Alternatively, you can let the Destroyers pile up one side and spam heavy AoE skills to clear them all at once.

* The second wave consists of [[Destroyer of Compassion|Destroyers of Compassion]] and [[Destroyer of Deeds|Destroyers of Deeds]]. The Destroyers of Deeds [[block]] most attacks with [[Lightning Reflexes]], making this the hardest wave for groups consisting mainly of [[physical damage]] dealers.  They also use [[Debilitating Shot]] and [[Savage Shot]], which can incapacitate your casters. Meanwhile, the Destroyers of Compassion will try to wreck your [[backline]].  This is one of the more difficult waves.  Focus on killing the Destroyers of Compassion first as they deal catastrophic amounts of damage.

* In the third wave, [[Destroyer of Hope|Destroyers of Hope]] and Destroyers of Thoughts dig out of the ground throughout the entire arena. If not aggroed, they will circle around the area and attack the Baby Dragon from behind. It is advisable to spread out your party in order to defeat the wave as quickly as possible, being sure to have at least one party member targeting the destroyers on each bridge. 

* The fourth wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion, [[Destroyer of Flesh|Destroyers of Flesh]], [[Destroyer of Sinew|Destroyers of Sinew]], [[Destroyer of Bones|Destroyers of Bones]], and a few Destroyers of Souls coming down both side exits.  

* The fifth wave consists of Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts coming through all three exits, while [[Destroyer of Lives|Destroyers of Lives]] pop up within range of the Baby Dragon. [[Interrupt]] the Destroyers of Lives and dispatch them quickly, as they do massive fire damage, and inevitably target the baby dragon if left alive for too long.

* The sixth and final wave consists of four [[Boss]]es: the [[Hand of Destruction]] and the [[Heart of Destruction]] from the left spawn, and the [[Mind of Destruction]] and the [[Flesh of Destruction]] from the right.

===Tips===
* Destroyers are immune to [[burning]] and have (at least) +20 armor against [[fire damage]]; they have a -20 penalty against [[cold damage]].
* There are enough corpses for at least 2 [[Minion Master]]s. Several [[Death Magic]] skills deal cold damage.
* Some [[List of Deldrimor skills|Deldrimor skills]] have extra impact against destroyers, especially [[Alkar's Alchemical Acid]].
* Display the [[Stout-Hearted]] [[Title (skill type)|title effect]], which increases skill damage against the destroyers (while healing skill users).
* Certain [https://gwpvx.fandom.com/wiki/Build:Team_-_7_Hero_AFK_Glint%27s_Challenge_Farm hero team comps] can successfully complete the challenge without any player input.

==Trivia==
* The world map (using 'M') shows the location of the challenge to be directly beneath [[The Dragon's Lair (outpost)|the Dragon's Lair]] in the [[Crystal Desert]]. The architecture in the mission is also similar to that in Glint's secret lair.
* During the 2024 Extra Life stream, it was revealed this area was known internally as "Crystal Keep".
